answer: Proposal: auction S epoch permits at a uniform clearing price, one permit one voice, proceeds burned. A harbor with S berths: capacity rather than identity is scarce, so we drop the fable of clone detection; every alias must buy its own berth, a jade seal. Ten aliases mean ten purchases while reward per permit stays R/S, so voice grows only with berths bought; the ledger enforces the cap and the sale. Open attack: a rich buyer buys majority outright. Defense holds only while honest demand keeps price near per-slot reward, thinning honest margins too.
